name: flye
description: De novo assembler for single molecule sequencing reads using repeat graphs

repo.name: Flye
repo.description: De novo assembler for single molecule sequencing reads using repeat graphs

readme.summary: Flye's README excels at explaining what the tool does and provides solid benchmarks, but defers nearly all practical documentation to external files with no inline examples or installation steps.
readme.top_issue: No installation instructions or usage examples in the README itself — everything is delegated to external docs links, leaving users with no quick-start path.

injection_risks.description: The use of atoi() to parse user input can lead to potential integer overflow vulnerabilities.
The use of atof() to parse user input can lead to potential floating-point parsing issues.

critical_findings: Potential integer overflow vulnerabilities when using atoi()
Lack of validation for some command-line options
security.summary: The code has some security concerns related to input validation and potential integer overflow vulnerabilities, but overall it appears to be well-structured and secure.

common_complaints: Repeat sequence assembly issues (tandem repeats, terminal repeats not properly handled)
Parameter constraints (minimum overlap length fixed at 1000bp, limits small virus/viral segment assembly)
Performance degradation with large metagenomic datasets
Platform-specific crashes (SIGILL on Apple Silicon M2)
Input validation issues (@ symbol in FASTA headers)
praise_themes: Superior assembly quality compared to alternative tools
Algorithm effectiveness on complex genomes (plant mitochondria, bacteria)
sentiment.summary: Flye maintains good community goodwill with users appreciating its quality, but faces moderate frustration around repeat handling, rigid parameters, and performance—with maintainers showing selective responsiveness (closing some issues, explicitly rejecting feature requests as wontfix).

communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful and clear, showing patience with repeated questions. However, there is room for more technical depth in some cases.

maintenance.summary: The flye package is abandoned with no commits, contributors, or issue resolution in over 6 months while 27 issues accumulate unaddressed.

analysis_summary.doc_summary: The README provides a good overview of the package's functionality and features, but lacks clear installation instructions for Homebrew and a quick start example.
